reason: The README describes a DeepSeek Harness plugin that automates tiered approval of tool calls through static rules, LLM review, and human fallback; human review is warranted because it can automatically authorize operations and transmit call data to a model.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供结合静态规则、LLM 审查和人工确认的工具调用分级审批。
summaries.en: Provides DeepSeek Harness with tiered tool-call approval using static rules, LLM review, and human confirmation.

capabilities: Applies configurable allow and deny rules
Uses an LLM to classify unresolved calls
Requests human confirmation for uncertain calls
Sends tool parameters and the latest user message to the review model
